metadata.title: Flashy Cardy Course
metadata.description: Master any subject with our interactive flashcard learning system.
metadata.pricingDescription: Choose the plan that fits your flashcard learning goals.

landing.heroDescription: Flashy Cardy is your personal flashcard platform. Create decks, build cards, and study with active recall — whether you're prepping for exams, learning a language, or picking up a new skill.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From blank deck to study session in three steps.
landing.step1Description: Name your topic and add a short description to set the scope.
landing.step2Description: Write cards yourself or generate them instantly with AI on Pro.
landing.step3Description: Run through your deck with flip cards, shuffle, and progress tracking.
landing.featuresSubtitle: A focused toolkit for creating and reviewing flashcards.
landing.featureOrganizeDescription: Group flashcards into decks for each subject, exam, or language so your study material stays structured and easy to find.
landing.featureBuildDescription: Add questions and answers manually, edit anytime, and keep every deck tailored to exactly what you need to learn.
landing.featureStudyDescription: Flip through cards, shuffle the deck, and track progress in a focused study session built for active recall.
landing.proSubtitle: Start free with up to {deckLimit} decks. Upgrade when you need more room and AI-powered card creation.
landing.proUnlimitedDescription: Free accounts include up to {deckLimit} decks. Pro removes the cap so you can manage every course, certification, and side project in one place.
landing.proAiDescription: Describe a topic and let AI create a full set of flashcards for you — with language, level, and format options to match how you learn.
landing.comparisonTitle: Free vs Pro at a glance
landing.comparisonDescription: Free: up to {deckLimit} decks, manual cards only. Pro: unlimited decks, and AI generation.
landing.ctaDescription: Create a free account and build your first deck in minutes.

study.addCardsBeforeStudying: Add cards to this deck before studying

study.noCardsHint: Add flashcards to this deck, then come back to study them

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitleBilling: Upgrade to Pro for unlimited decks, and AI generation.
pricing.subtitleDemo: Compare plans and activate free Demo Pro — no charges during the public demo.
pricing.freeDescription: Start learning with manual flashcards and up to {deckLimit} decks.
pricing.proDescription: Remove deck limits and generate full flashcard sets with AI.
pricing.proFeatureAi: AI flashcard generation from any topic
pricing.demoBannerDescription: FlashyCardy is running as a public demo. Pro subscriptions and payments are not available yet. Activate free Demo Pro below to unlock unlimited decks and AI generation — subject to demo usage limits.
pricing.demoProActiveTitle: Demo Pro is active on your account
pricing.demoProActiveDescription: You have free Demo Pro access — unlimited decks and AI flashcard generation under demo usage limits. This is not a paid subscription.
pricing.waitlistInterestTitle: Interested in full Pro when it launches?
pricing.waitlistInterestDescription: Join the waitlist for free — we'll notify you when paid Pro becomes available. Optional and separate from your Demo Pro access.
pricing.activateSignInDescription: Sign in to unlock unlimited decks and AI generation on your account. No payment required during the public demo.
pricing.activateDescription: Unlock unlimited decks and AI flashcard generation instantly. Demo Pro is free access for testing — not a paid subscription. AI usage remains subject to demo limits.
pricing.activateFailed: Failed to activate Demo Pro. Please try again.
pricing.activatedDescription: Your account now has free Demo Pro access. Would you like to join the Pro waitlist? It's optional — you can skip and start using Pro features right away.
